# EON Group

> EON Group designs, builds and supports modern websites for businesses in Greece, with SEO structure, responsive development, web support and digital marketing.

Website: https://eon-group.vercel.app/
Contact: eongroupgr@gmail.com
Phone: +30 6946934533
Language: Greek, with English service terminology where useful.

## Services

- Website Design: visual direction, conversion-focused structure, landing pages, business websites and eshop presentation.
- Responsive Development: fast, stable websites that work on mobile, tablet and desktop.
- SEO Structure: clean headings, service pages, technical metadata, content hierarchy and search-ready site structure.
- Digital Marketing: Google Ads campaigns, social media promotion, campaign direction and small TikTok or short-form video requests on request.
- Web Support: maintenance, fixes, content updates, backups and practical improvements after launch.
